enabledByDefault.Name: Use phases in new combats
enabledByDefault.Hint: New combats start with phased initiative turned on. It can be switched per combat before it starts.

autoAdvance.Name: Advance the phase automatically when everyone marks Done
autoAdvance.Hint: When off, the GM advances every phase by hand.

defaultDc.Name: Default DC
defaultDc.Hint: The DC a new combat starts with. Characters who meet it act in Fast.

showDcToPlayers.Name: Show the DC to players
showDcToPlayers.Hint: When off, only the GM sees the combat's DC.

openOnStart.Name: Open the phase window when combat starts
openOnStart.Hint: Opens the phase window on this client whenever a phased combat begins.

phaseTemplate.Name: Phase template
phaseTemplate.Hint: The ordered phases each new combat copies.

Config.MenuHint: Phase order, DC and the other options of SC - Venaerys's Initiative.
Config.Title: SC - Venaerys's Initiative · Settings

Phases.Intro: Order of the phases in each round. Combats in progress don't change.
Phases.Band: Party turn: extra phases here act in the middle of it
Phases.BuiltinHint: Built-in phase: can't be deleted or renamed
Phases.RestoreBody: Restore the default phases? The extra phases you created and the names you changed will be lost. Combats in progress don't change.
Phases.DeleteBody: Delete the phase '{name}'? Combats in progress don't change.

TurnEvents.Title: Turn events
TurnEvents.Body: Automatic start-of-turn effects (recharges, ongoing damage, reaction) happen for every member at the start of the phase. Automatic end-of-turn effects only happen for the highlighted member, at the end of the phase. Everyone else resolves end-of-turn effects (saving throws, effects that last until the end of their next turn) by hand when marking Done.

Unconfirmed.Title: Starting without confirmation
Unconfirmed.Body: When a player starts the combat, a player uses Next turn in round 0, or a macro or integration starts it with the confirmed option, there is no confirmation dialog: anyone who has not rolled goes straight to Slow this round.

Pending.Title: Pending combatants
Pending.Body: Anyone who hasn't rolled initiative sits at the end of Foundry's order and gets the system's turn events at the round change. Once they roll, they join the phase their result gives.

Conflicts.Title: Modules with conflicting options
Conflicts.Body: midi-qol: "reroll initiative each round" and "record attacks of opportunity". Combat Tracker Dock: "hide enemies until their first turn". We recommend turning these options off in combats with phases.

Movement.Title: Foundry v14
Movement.Body: In v14, the movement history of every combatant is cleared at each turn start. With phases, that happens at the start of each phase.

Tracker.Title: Combat Phases
Tracker.PhasesOff: Phased initiative is off in this combat.
Tracker.YouPending: You haven't rolled initiative yet. Roll from the tracker or your sheet.
Tracker.PastLocked: Only the GM can unmark a finished phase.

Gm.PhasesLockedHint: Phases can only be turned on or off in round 0.
Gm.AdvanceLabel: Advance from {phase} to the next phase
Gm.CompleteLabel: Mark everyone in {phase} done and advance
Gm.BackLabel: Go back from {phase} to the previous phase
Gm.AdvanceAnywayHint: Whoever hasn't rolled acts in {slow} this round; if they roll and beat the DC before {fast} ends, they join {fast} right away.
Gm.DialogWaitHint: The phase is complete. Close the dialog or advance now.
Gm.PhaseCompleteHint: Automatic advance is off. Advance when the table is ready.
Gm.NoPhasesHint: Every combatant is defeated or has no phase. The round won't turn by itself.

Start.Title: Start combat
Start.IfStartOne: If you start now, they act in {slow} this round. If they roll and beat the DC before {fast} ends, they join {fast} right away.
Start.IfStartMany: If you start now, they act in {slow} this round. Anyone who rolls and beats the DC before {fast} ends joins {fast} right away.
Start.FastEmpty: Nobody from the party is in {fast} yet: it will be skipped this round.

Notifications.NoEarlierPhase: There is no previous phase: the combat started in this phase. To change who acts now, move the combatant to the current phase.
Notifications.OnlyGmBack: Only the GM can go back phases.
